description: This file contains functions to format test scripts' output into JUnit XML format, specifically tailored for integration with Git test suite results and Azure Pipelines. It manages test output, case start and end, finalization, and XML encoding.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes the JUnit XML report for a test script, creating the directory and starting the testsuite element with attributes.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Records the start time of a test case.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Completes the test case report with status, message, and timing, committing it to the XML report.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Finalizes the entire test report, updates timing, and closes the XML tags.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Helper to write XML content to the report file, optionally truncating the file.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes strings for XML attributes, ensuring special characters are properly escaped.
